description: Published thermal (2200 m/s) absorption cross sections used as external reference cases.
quantity: absorption = sum of the evaluated MT18 (fission) and MT102-MT117 (capture and charged-particle) channels present in the data
agreement_rule: AGREES if |evaluated - reference| <= k * u_ref (k = 3, reference uncertainty only; evaluation uncertainty is not propagated). DISCREPANT if larger but within gross_error_bound_rel. FAIL beyond that bound.
gross_error_bound_meaning: Catches parsing/processing errors only. It is NOT a physics-accuracy claim.

reference.citation: V. F. Sears, 'Neutron scattering lengths and cross sections', Neutron News 3(3), 26-37 (1992)
reference.retrieved_from: https://ncnr.nist.gov/resources/n-lengths/list.html (NIST Center for Neutron Research, column 'absorption cross section for 2200 m/s neutrons')
reference.caveat: The NIST page states the values were entered by hand from the paper and may contain errors. Only values with a quoted uncertainty are used.

cases.known_discrepancy_note: Evaluated value is ~0.8% above the 1992 compilation (about 4.8 sigma of its stated uncertainty). Possible causes (NOT verified here): later evaluation incorporating new standards/CIELO work vs a 1992 compilation; 0 K vs room-temperature definition. Reported, not hidden; a newer reference (e.g. ENDF/B-VIII.0 standards thermal constants, Carlson et al., Nucl. Data Sheets 148, 143 (2018), Sec. 3.3) was not retrieved.
